__comment: Override of Tinkers' Thinking. Upstream is ["#","#"] of forge:cobblestone, identical to cb_microblock:stone_rod from CB Multipart, so only one of the two could be crafted. That matters both ways: stone_rod feeds Project Red's four saws (gold, peridot, ruby, sapphire) and stone_stick feeds Tinkers' Thinking's stone torch, soul torch, ladder and the rock tool material. Laid flat here because stone_rod is the more widely documented of the two and Project Red's saws are a progression item. Same materials, same count of 4.
